deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC/PSSC tooling
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with Intersect administering funds and later transferring project funding to a Project-Specific Smart Contract.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development through Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: Mithril is presented as solving slow full-node synchronization and centralized trust reliance for light clients by using stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state.
The proposal states that Mithril enables rapid, trustless verification of Cardano state for nodes and applications without relying on the entire chain.

The proposal states that continued Mithril funding supports decentralization by reducing dependency on centralized indexers and hosted APIs during increased governance activity, ecosystem expansion, and scaling pressure.
The proposal claims full alignment with Infrastructure & Research Excellence and Adoption & Utility, and partial alignment with Community & Ecosystem Growth.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audited-results references.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission and links to the referenced governance action.
The budget allocates 3,699,440 ada to Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada to an Intersect Budget Administration fee, totaling 3,810,423 ada.

The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in overhead and that Intersect plus technically capable third parties will provide reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
The proposal states Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding, while IOG has funded its Mithril work to date.

The proposal identifies Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, TRSC/PSSC addresses, role thresholds, oversight committee members, documentation, dashboard, GitHub repository, and audit-report references for fund administration.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol, mostly for continuous development, administered by Intersect via treasury smart contracts with cited voting, audit, contract, and dashboard references.
